duel.beyondsolo.notify.title: Duel · %s
duel.beyondsolo.notify.coming.test: %s is on the way to see what your S-rank is worth.
duel.beyondsolo.notify.coming.passed: %s is coming to take back their place on the national rankings.
duel.beyondsolo.notify.coming.grudge: %s is coming to settle it: you walked out on their guild.
duel.beyondsolo.notify.coming.asked: %s took up your request: they're on their way to you.
duel.beyondsolo.notify.waiting.test: %s wants to test your S-rank, and will wait %s minutes. They'll come to you once you're out in the world.
duel.beyondsolo.notify.waiting.passed: %s wants their place on the rankings back, and will wait %s minutes. They'll come to you once you're out in the world.
duel.beyondsolo.notify.waiting.grudge: %s wants to settle your walk-out, and will wait %s minutes. They'll come to you once you're out in the world.
duel.beyondsolo.notify.waiting.asked: %s took up your request, and will wait %s minutes. They'll come to you once you're out in the world.
duel.beyondsolo.notify.lapsed: %s's challenge lapsed: you didn't answer it.
duel.beyondsolo.notify.result.lost.body: You yielded to %s. Grow stronger, and ask for a rematch at the Association.
duel.beyondsolo.notify.result.drawn.body: Time ran out. Neither you nor %s gave way.
duel.beyondsolo.notify.result.forfeit.bo: You left the ring. The duel goes to %s.
duel.beyondsolo.notify.national.title: National-level hunter
duel.beyondsolo.notify.national: You have beaten all four national-level hunters. The Association names you a national-level hunter.
duel.beyondsolo.say.done: I've said what I came to say.
duel.beyondsolo.say.gave_up: I'll leave word with the Association. Answer it there before it lapses.
duel.beyondsolo.greet.test.han_seori: %1$s. Han Seo-ri, of the %2$s. Every new S-rank gets a visit from one of us. Let's see if yours is real.
duel.beyondsolo.greet.test.viktor_kael: So you're the new S-rank, %1$s. Viktor Kael, %2$s. A rank is just a letter. Show me.
duel.beyondsolo.greet.test.amara_okafor: %1$s! Amara Okafor, %2$s. The Association says you're S-rank now. I came to see for myself.
duel.beyondsolo.greet.test.ren_takashiro: %1$s. Ren Takashiro. No guild, no rules. New S-ranks interest me. Shall we?
duel.beyondsolo.greet.passed.han_seori: %1$s. This morning's rankings put you above me. I'd like to see if they're right.
duel.beyondsolo.greet.passed.viktor_kael: You passed me on the board, %1$s. The %2$s doesn't like being second. Neither do I.
duel.beyondsolo.greet.passed.amara_okafo: %1$s, you took my place on the national rankings. I'm here to take it back.
duel.beyondsolo.greet.passed.ren_takashi: Above me on the rankings, %1$s? Prove it.
duel.beyondsolo.greet.grudge.han_seori: You walked out on the %2$s, %1$s. Nobody leaves us like that. I've come to settle it.
duel.beyondsolo.greet.grudge.viktor_kael: The %2$s took you in, %1$s, and you walked out. We settle this the old way.
duel.beyondsolo.greet.grudge.amara_okafo: You broke your word to the %2$s, %1$s. Sunfall's honour wants an answer.
duel.beyondsolo.greet.grudge.ren_takashi: %1$s. You walked out on somebody. I don't care who. I just wanted the excuse.
duel.beyondsolo.greet.asked.han_seori: The Association says you asked for me, %1$s. I don't refuse a duel.
duel.beyondsolo.greet.asked.viktor_kael: You asked for a fight with me, %1$s? Brave. Let's go.
duel.beyondsolo.greet.asked.amara_okafor: You wanted a duel, %1$s? I'm all yours.
duel.beyondsolo.greet.asked.ren_takashir: You asked for me, %1$s. Most people try very hard not to.
duel.beyondsolo.say.begin.han_seori: Inside the ring. Don't hold back on my account.
duel.beyondsolo.say.begin.viktor_kael: Let's see what you're made of.
duel.beyondsolo.say.begin.amara_okafor: On the bell. Try to keep up.
duel.beyondsolo.say.unleash.han_seori: Enough holding back. Let the tide come in!
duel.beyondsolo.say.unleash.viktor_kael: You want the Titan? You'll get him!
duel.beyondsolo.say.unleash.amara_okafor: Let's see you outrun the dawn!
duel.beyondsolo.say.unleash.ren_takashir: You won't see the next one coming.
duel.beyondsolo.say.later.han_seori: Fine. I'll be back in %s minutes. Be ready.
duel.beyondsolo.say.later.viktor_kael: %s minutes. Don't make me wait longer than that.
duel.beyondsolo.say.later.amara_okafor: I'll find you again in %s minutes.
duel.beyondsolo.say.later.ren_takashiro: %s minutes. I'll find you, wherever you are.
duel.beyondsolo.say.declined.han_seori: A pity. I'd hoped you were more than a rank.
duel.beyondsolo.say.declined.amara_okafo: Your choice. The news won't be kind.
duel.beyondsolo.say.declined.ren_takashi: Smart. Or scared. We'll see which.
duel.beyondsolo.say.won.viktor_kael: Ha! I yield. You hit harder than anyone in my guild, %s.
duel.beyondsolo.say.won.amara_okafor: I yield. Remember this sunrise, %s. It's yours.
duel.beyondsolo.say.won.ren_takashiro: I yield. Nobody has ever seen me coming. Until you, %s.
duel.beyondsolo.say.lost.han_seori: Get up, %s. You're not there yet.
duel.beyondsolo.say.lost.viktor_kael: Stay down. Come back when you're stronger, %s.
duel.beyondsolo.say.lost.ren_takashiro: Too slow, %s. Next time, watch my shadow.
duel.beyondsolo.say.drawn.han_seori: Time. We'll finish this another day, %s.
duel.beyondsolo.say.drawn.viktor_kael: Time's up. Not bad at all, %s.
duel.beyondsolo.say.drawn.amara_okafor: The sun's set on this one, %s. Again some day.
duel.beyondsolo.say.forfeit.han_seori: Leaving the ring is giving up, %s.
duel.beyondsolo.say.forfeit.viktor_kael: You stepped out, %s. That's a loss.
duel.beyondsolo.say.forfeit.amara_okafor: Out of the ring, out of the duel, %s.
duel.beyondsolo.outcome.unregistered: Only an evaluated hunter can duel.
duel.beyondsolo.outcome.rank: The national-level hunters only duel hunters of rank %s and above.
duel.beyondsolo.outcome.rematch: %s won't duel you again yet: %s more days.
duel.beyondsolo.outcome.asked: The Association sent your request to %s. They'll come to you.
duel.beyondsolo.outcome.not_here: Not here. Go back out into the world, on your feet and out of any fight.
duel.beyondsolo.outcome.no_room: There's no room here for a ring. Find open ground.
duel.beyondsolo.outcome.accepted: You took up %s's challenge. The ring is marked out.

news.beyondsolo.duel.won.grudge: %1$s beats %2$s, the %3$s's own, in the duel over their walk-out.
news.beyondsolo.duel.won_again.passed: %1$s beats %2$s again and stays ahead on the rankings.
news.beyondsolo.duel.won_again.grudge: %1$s beats %2$s again: the %3$s has no answer.
news.beyondsolo.duel.lost.test: %2$s tested the new S-rank %1$s, and found them wanting.
news.beyondsolo.duel.lost.passed: %2$s takes back their place, beating %1$s in a duel.
news.beyondsolo.duel.lost.grudge: %2$s settles it: %1$s loses the duel over the walk-out from the %3$s.
news.beyondsolo.duel.lost.asked: %1$s asked %2$s for a duel, and lost.
news.beyondsolo.duel.forfeit: %1$s steps out of the ring: %2$s wins their duel by forfeit.

ui.beyondsolo.duel.title: Challenge
ui.beyondsolo.duel.why.test: %1$s came to see whether your S-rank is real.
ui.beyondsolo.duel.why.passed: You passed %1$s on the national rankings. They want their place back.
ui.beyondsolo.duel.why.grudge: You walked out on the %2$s. %1$s came to settle it.
ui.beyondsolo.duel.why.asked: You asked the Association for a duel with %1$s.

ui.beyondsolo.duel.head: A CHALLENGE
ui.beyondsolo.duel.level.yours: A test: they fight at your level (%s).
ui.beyondsolo.duel.stake.loss: Lose, and nothing is taken: you yield before the blow that would kill you, and they help you back up.
ui.beyondsolo.duel.rule.ring: A ring %s blocks across. Stay inside: %s seconds out of it and you forfeit.
ui.beyondsolo.duel.rule.time: %s on the clock. If neither of you yields by then, it's a draw.
ui.beyondsolo.duel.rule.alone: One on one: nobody else's blows land in the ring, and monsters are kept out.
ui.beyondsolo.duel.hint.accept: The ring is marked out where you stand, and the count begins.
ui.beyondsolo.duel.hint.accept_office: %s comes to you, and the ring is marked out where you stand.
ui.beyondsolo.duel.hint.later: They leave, and come back in a few minutes (%s more times).
ui.beyondsolo.duel.hint.decline: They leave, and the news hears that you turned them down.
ui.beyondsolo.duel.hint.decline_asked: They leave. You asked for this one, so nobody hears of it.
ui.beyondsolo.duel.office.title: NATIONAL-LEVEL HUNTERS
ui.beyondsolo.duel.office.rank: The national-level hunters only duel hunters of rank %s and above.
ui.beyondsolo.duel.office.waiting: Waiting for your answer · lapses in %s
ui.beyondsolo.duel.office.no.dueling: You're in a duel right now.
ui.beyondsolo.duel.office.no.rank: Rank %s or above to ask for a duel.
ui.beyondsolo.duel.office.hint.ask: Ask the Association for a duel with %s. They come to you.
ui.beyondsolo.duel.office.pays: A win pays %s gold, %s merit and %s System XP. Lose, and you yield before the killing blow.
ui.beyondsolo.duel.office.rules: The ring: %s blocks across · %s on the clock · %s seconds outside it forfeits · nobody else may step in.
ui.beyondsolo.duel.hud.line.drawn: Time ran out. Neither of you gave way.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.duel.challe: A challenge from that national-level hunter (for the reason given, asked if none), opening now.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.duel.send: The challenger sets out for the player now, from behind them, out of sight.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.duel.talk: The challenge's window, from the challenger near the player.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.duel.start: A duel with them begins now where the player stands: they step out of the air.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.duel.bell: Skips the count: they fight now.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.duel.move: The challenger begins that move now (one of their own style, or unleash).
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.duel.unleas: The challenger shows what they really are now.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.duel.end: Ends the duel under way: won, lost, drawn or called off.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.duel.info: The player's record against each of them, and the challenge standing.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.duel.reset: Forgets the player's duels and the challenge standing; the challengers go home.
command.beyondsolo.solo.duel.unleashed: %s: the challenger shows what they really are.
command.beyondsolo.solo.duel.record: %s · won %s · lost %s · drawn %s · turned down %s · forfeits %s%s%s
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.duel_move: %s: no duel of theirs is under way, or %s isn't one of the challenger's moves.
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.no_duel_sp: There's nowhere for the challenger to come to %s from.
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.no_duel_ch: No challenger of %s's is near them.
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.duel_unlea: %s: no duel of theirs is under way, or the challenger is unleashed already.
